name: @estebanforge/pi-slack-me
description: Slack read tools for Pi that act as YOU, not as a bot. Adds 5 LLM-callable tools (slack_*) that read channels, threads, DMs, and search results using a Slack USER token (xoxp-). No bot to invite, no footprint in the workspace - the app inherits your own m
